mpi-1.title: To Be, Pronouns & There is/are — English
mpi-1.description: Interactive learning media that guides learners to discover for themselves how am/is/are, personal pronouns, possessive adjectives, this/that/these/those, and there is/there are are used to state the identity and existence of people and things.

mpi-2.title: Place, Quantity & Time — English
mpi-2.description: Interactive learning media that guides learners to discover for themselves what decides a regular plural ending, which word places a thing in space, which word places an event in time, and which question word asks for each of them.

mpi-3.title: Simple Present: Habits & Facts — English
mpi-3.description: Interactive learning media that guides learners to discover for themselves when the simple present is used for a habit and when for a fact, which subjects give the verb its -s/-es/-ies ending, and how the same sentence turns into a negative and into a question.

mpi-4.title: Present Continuous: Happening Now — English
mpi-4.description: Interactive learning media that guides learners to discover for themselves when English uses am/is/are + verb-ing for an action in progress and when it uses the plain verb for a routine, how the -ing is spelled, and how the same sentence turns into a negative and into a question — ending in a live broadcast the learners script and read aloud themselves.
